answer: Identities form a trust graph; each new identity must receive gale endorsements from established identities (established > tundra epochs). Endorsers stake mesa tokens per endorsement, slashed if the endorsee is later proven sybil. SybilRank propagates trust scores from seed nodes; low-score nodes have actions rate-limited. Attack cost: each fake identity needs endorsements from real users, who risk stake. The stake requirement grows with the number of endorsements an endorser gives, limiting sybil farm scale. Verification runs off-chain (indexer) with on-chain stake checks.
